proposed_comments.title: Bound all package, XML, image, and geometry work
proposed_comments.body:
### Bound all package, XML, image, and geometry work

**Severity:** `critical`

Explorer requests thumbnails automatically for files it enumerates, but the current loader copies embedded images and parses package XML and geometry without complete resource limits. A crafted 3MF can use oversized or highly compressed entries, huge decoded image dimensions, external-entity XML, deep component graphs, or very large mesh collections to exhaust memory or stall the thumbnail process. Please enforce per-entry and aggregate package limits, safe XML readers with DTD processing prohibited, decoded-image dimension limits, bounded vertices/triangles/components/depth, and preserve indexed vertices rather than duplicating three coordinates for every triangle.

proposed_comments.title: Resolve the declared root model and reachable component graph
proposed_comments.body:
### Resolve the declared root model and reachable component graph

**Severity:** `high`

Loading every `.model` entry as an independent root renders referenced production parts twice, includes unreachable parts, and can let an unused malformed part suppress the thumbnail. Objects defined through `<components>` are also skipped because only direct meshes are indexed, while relative `p:path` references and per-part units can place or scale cross-part geometry incorrectly. Resolve the OPC root-model relationship, traverse only reachable build items and components recursively with cycle detection, resolve paths relative to the containing part, compose transforms, and normalize every part to a common unit.

proposed_comments.title: Make the native worker handoff fail safely and terminate
proposed_comments.body:
### Make the native worker handoff fail safely and terminate

**Severity:** `high`

`GetThumbnail` can currently report `S_OK` without a valid bitmap, consume an uninitialized read count after an `IStream::Read` failure, wait forever for the managed worker, and leak process or stream handles on failure paths. A malformed file can therefore block Explorer thumbnail generation for subsequent files or expose invalid output state. Validate and initialize both output parameters at entry, propagate stream and file errors, use scoped ownership for COM and process handles, impose a finite worker timeout with cleanup, verify the produced bitmap, and return a failing HRESULT whenever no valid `HBITMAP` is produced.

proposed_comments.title: Handle non-seekable inputs in one bounded pass
proposed_comments.body:
### Handle non-seekable inputs in one bounded pass

**Severity:** `medium`

The embedded-thumbnail probe consumes a non-seekable stream, and the mesh fallback cannot rewind it before opening the package again, so valid mesh-only content returns no thumbnail. Buffer a non-seekable input once with the same package-size cap, or inspect the thumbnail and model through a single archive pass. Please add deterministic coverage for mesh-only non-seekable streams, root relationships, recursive and cross-part components, relative paths, unit conversion, malformed inputs, and a fuzz target for the untrusted package boundary.
